purpose.summary: Resolves contradictory drift signals and dimensional interference paradoxes by decomposing them into dominant gradient vectors.
purpose.detail: The PGA is activated whenever two or more overlay signals produce contradictory readings — for example, when the Drift Sentinel and Coherence Tensor Engine report opposing state assessments, or when the DRM contains a paradoxical interference/resonance overlap. The PGA decomposes the contradiction field into its constituent gradient vectors using a weighted spectral analysis, identifies the dominant gradient, and emits a resolved signal set. The PGA operates across the Drift, Coherence, Dimensional, and Domain overlays as a tertiary conflict-resolution engine.
